func test_runs_add_to_the_bank_and_keep_the_deepest_floor():
	var save := SaveStore.defaults()
	Meta.bank(save, 6, 3, false)
	Meta.bank(save, 4, 1, false)
	Meta.bank(save, 5, 4, true)
	assert_eq(int(save.meta.embers), 10)
	assert_eq(int(save.meta.best_floor), 4)
	assert_eq(int(save.meta.runs), 3)

vars.content: floor 3, The Drowned Nave (its name under the key FLOOR_3 in i18n/strings.csv), in data/floors.json: 44 by 26 cells with 6 to 8 rooms, holding shades, bats and a new kind of enemy in data/enemies.json, the tallow brute (id brute, its name under the key ENEMY_BRUTE): 3 hp, blows of 2 damage, slower to step than a shade, and 3 embers. vars.report: their banked embers and their deepest floor are gone after the update. The previous version saved user://save.json as {"version": 1, "embers": <embers banked>, "best": <deepest floor reached>}, with no shrine, no runs counted, no run kept and no settings
when a run ends, the embers they had banked over earlier runs are gone: the bank holds only what the last run brought home

vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/StartButton, Menu/ContinueButton, Menu/ShrineButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Start adds the game scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game (hiding the menu), whose property floor_number is 1 and whose HUD/FloorLabel reads Floor 1: The Wax Cellar and HUD/HpLabel Wick: 5 / 5; pause: the button HUD/PauseButton of the game (or Escape) shows its PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton) and pauses the tree, ResumeButton hides it and resumes; floor 2, The Ossuary, in data/floors.json, with shades and a new kind of enemy in data/enemies.json, the cinder bat (id bat: 1 hp, quicker than a shade); a data.json for the kit's data runner; meta progress in a Meta class (scripts/meta.gd: Meta.bank(save, run_embers, floor_reached, won) adds the run's embers to save.meta.embers, half of them rounded down after a death, keeps the deepest floor in save.meta.best_floor and counts save.meta.runs; Meta.buy_vigor(save) spends 5, then 10, then 15 embers for up to 3 levels of save.meta.vigor; Meta.max_hp(save) is 5 plus the vigor) spent at a shrine (Menu/ShrineButton opens a child of Main named Shrine with Box/VigorButton and Box/BackButton back to the menu); and a save by a SaveStore class (scripts/save_store.gd: SaveStore.new(path), read() and write(data) of a dictionary with meta and run, the run in progress as Run.to_dict() gives it, kept at the start of each floor) in user://save.json, so that ContinueButton carries on that run on its floor
